observations: Yellow metal wheel clamp fitted around a car tire
Circular yellow hub cover over the wheel center
Long yellow arm spanning the tire tread with black crank handles at the end
No readable brand or model on the device
Watermark reads 'HIPHEN SOLUTIONS POSTED ON JIJI'

claims.claim: Patented hub cover protects against lug nut removal
claims.evidence: Photo shows a hub cover but cannot verify patent status or protective function
Photo 0 shows a crank handle assembly on the yellow arm

risks.risk: Lock may not work or key may be missing
risks.proof: Photo or video of the key turning the lock and the clamp opening and closing

risks.risk: Clamp arms or welds may be bent, cracked, or repaired
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all joints, welds, and the full length of both arms

risks.risk: Rubber tire-contact pads may be missing or worn
risks.proof: Close-up photos of where the yellow metal touches the tire

risks.risk: Crank mechanism may be seized or stripped
risks.proof: Video of the crank being turned smoothly through its range

proof_requests: Video of the key locking and unlocking the clamp
Close-up photos of all welds, joints, and arm ends
Close-up photos of the rubber pads contacting the tire
Video of the crank handle turning the mechanism
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a wheel clamp from the photo, so it can be priced at its worst case even though the seller's claims about the patent and operation are unproven.
